6.180 rsWrongNumberOfMatrixRows
Applies to RDL 2003/10 and RDL 2005/01
rsWrongNumberOfMatrixRows is a critical error that will occur when a Matrix contains a different
number of MatrixRow elements than the number of StaticRow elements. If the matrix contains no
StaticRow element, the matrix will contain exactly one MatrixRow element.
